summary: Conditional full-spatial canonical-metric Hamiltonian selector, explicit vacuum evolution and tensor dynamics; microscopic Theta selection remains open.

stage_events.description: Requested integration of remaining working research and prioritization of unresolved dynamics. This direction does not approve the newly proposed reduced Hamiltonian ansatz or attest its derivation.

Chose to test normalized off-shell refoliation in an explicit reduced metric Hamiltonian family before any homogeneous truncation, rather than claim dynamics from the nonlinear Cartan coordinate lift.

Derived the general spatial bracket including the independent momentum-trace gradient, coefficient conditions, full vacuum evolution, Legendre form and flat tensor waves. These are restricted reproductions of standard geometrodynamical structures, not a new general-relativity theorem.
Added exact symmetric-tensor checks, finite Lean cores and a separate Fourier/finite-difference evaluation of the curvature-functional bracket on genuinely three-dimensional periodic data.

rejected_alternatives: Treating homogeneous bracket closure as full spatial refoliation.
Calling every non-Einstein trace coefficient inconsistent despite different possible second-class branches.
Treating a kinematic right inverse as a proof of the reduced canonical symplectic form.
Claiming microscopic action selection or a numerical Newton prediction from the metric coefficient relations.

verification.limitations: The full functional bracket has an analytic derivation with CAS and independent numerical cross-checks; Lean scope is finite algebra only. Microscopic and global statements remain open.
